sloka: तस्यामग्निं विशन्त्यां तु हाहेति विपुलस्वनः ।रक्षसां वानराणां च सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः ।। ६.११९.३४ ।।
transliteration: tasyāmagniṁ viśantyāṁ tu hāheti vipulasvanaḥ ।rakṣasāṁ vānarāṇāṁ ca sambabhūvādbhutopamaḥ ।। 6.119.34 ।।

translations.english: All the women who stood there fled, screaming on seeing Sita falling into fire, like the flow of ghee poured continuously into sacrificial fire reciting sacred verses by priests.
